paragraphs: The S-Type R is the high-performance flagship of the S-Type range, powered by a supercharged 4.2-litre AJ-V8. Fitted across the entire X200 generation from 1999 to 2008, it shares its fundamental architecture with the naturally aspirated 4.2-litre V8 but adds an Eaton supercharger to produce significantly more power. It's a different engine variant from the standard V8, with its own specific supercharger, intercooler, and engine management calibration - which means a rebuild requires specialist knowledge of the supercharged AJ-V8's particular components and tolerances. The S-Type R is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ-V8 (supercharged) engines for every S-Type R on the road.

cards.body: A 4.2-litre supercharged V8 fitted to the S-Type R from 1999 to 2008 (X200 generation). Known for timing chain stretch between 80,000-150,000km, with tensioners and guide rails wearing alongside the chain - see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, and guide rails as standard on every AJ-V8 supercharged rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The S-Type R uses the supercharged AJ-V8 across its entire production run - there's only one engine code for this variant. That said, running changes to components and ECU calibrations occurred during the 1999-2008 period, so we always confirm your exact build details via registration before quoting or supplying any parts. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build
This protects you from compatibility issues that could arise from assuming all S-Type R engines are identical.
